purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian fiscal/tax management system - Situação Tributária (Tax Situation) screen 01.13.27, handling ICMS tax origin and taxation codes for merchandise
purpose.summary: This program implements a web-based CGI listing screen for 'Situação Tributária' (Tax Situation), managing ICMS taxation codes and merchandise origin codes. It supports pagination (next page, previous page, go-to) and renders HTML output via the htmlpp preprocessor. It reads from files pd11100 (situacao-tributaria) and pd11000 (tributacao-icms).

notable_features: EXEC HTML...END-EXEC blocks for HTML generation
external-form with 'identified by' CGI input mapping
Heavy use of COPY statements (11 copybooks)
Commented-out code with *>A/*>M annotations indicating modifications
verdict.notes: The *>A and *>M inline comments on moved/commented lines suggest version control annotations (A=anterior/old, M=modificado/modified). The program is part of a larger Brazilian ERP or fiscal management system. The htmlpp preprocessor is associated with GnuCOBOL-based web CGI frameworks used in Brazil. No EXEC CICS but EXEC HTML is used instead; program_type set to online-cics as closest match for interactive web/CGI program.
